2023.ZB2.11.s:
This report focuses on the primary activities and achievements of the Strategic Communications Branch at the Toronto Zoo for the year 2022. The Strategic Communications team oversees all of the public facing communications to connect our audiences to our animals, messages, events and activities and onsite marketing opportunities for our guests.

Once again, our Strategic Communications team was faced with a challenging year balancing the exciting opportunities that accompanied a return to longer term “regular” on-site operations, paired with the ongoing content management of very successful digital and virtual audience connections that we have invested great effort into building during the past few years.

Included in this report is a snapshot of some of the key activities, statistics and achievements of our efforts over the past year.

Three attachments are included with this report to represent information visually.

2023.ZB3.8.s:
In accordance with Section 35(a) of By-law 1-2012 the Procedures By-law of the Board of Management of Toronto Zoo, this letter serves as notice that the Board will consider amendments to the Procedures By-law at the next meeting of the Board of Management of Toronto Zoo. The amendments are related to permitting the continuation of electronic participation at meetings and the time required to achieve quorum increased from 15 minutes to 30 minutes.

City Council at its meeting on March 29, 30 and 31, 2023 considered Item EX3.7 Making Electronic Participation for Council and its Local Boards Permanent and, among other things, has authorized local boards to also amend their rules of procedure with respect to these matters without having to seek further Council approval.

2023.ZB4.3.t: Making Electronic Participation Permanent for the Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo
2023.ZB4.3.s:
The purpose of this report is to recommend amendments to the Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo Procedural By-Law to make electronic participation a permanent option for meetings.

At its meeting of March 29, 30 and 31, 2023, City Council adopted Item EX3.7, and in so doing has authorized local boards governed by the City of Toronto Act, 2006, to amend their own rules of procedure to permit electronic participation by board members and the public, and to change the time required to achieve quorum from 15 minutes to 30 minutes, and authorize such boards to continue to meet electronically in accordance with the previously adopted electronic participation rules past the May 9, 2023 deadline until they can meet to consider procedural amendments.
2023.ZB4.3.r:
The City Clerk recommends that the Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo:

1. Amend the Zoo Board Procedural By-Law 1-2012 to:

a. permit electronic participation in all meetings; and

b. allow 30 minutes instead of 15 minutes to achieve quorum

2. Adopt the draft bill in Attachment 1 to the report (June 5, 2023) from the City Clerk to implement Recommendation 1.

2023.ZB5.4.t: Energy Retrofit Project Change of Scope
2023.ZB5.4.s:
This report is to provide an update on the Change of Scope for the Peak Shaving Component of the Energy Retrofit Project. Further work on this project has shown that the existing Generac generators used for site-wide emergency back up are in need of replacement, and therefore not the best equipment to be used for the Peak Shaving Conservation Measure of the original Energy Retrofit Project.

At this time, the Zoo will be replacing the Peak Shaving Conservation Measure as approved by the Board with a heating and cooling system replacement conservation measure in Africa Pavilion and Indo Malaya Pavilion which will include heat pumps and new boilers similar to the Americas Pavilion Energy Retrofit Project. This alternative measure will realize an additional 409 tonnes of annual greenhouse gas emission savings of the original scope of the Energy Retrofit Project.
2023.ZB5.4.r:
The Director, Facilities and Infrastructure, Toronto Zoo recommends that:

1. The Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo receives this report for information.
